name: courtlistener
description: US case law and court records via CourtListener / Free Law Project. One corpus, three modalities: opinion text, scanned record pages, oral-argument audio.

fields.name: court.id
fields.description: Court identifier, e.g. 'ca9' for the 9th Circuit.

fields.name: docket.court_id
fields.description: The court this docket belongs to, e.g. 'ca9'.

fields.name: docket.date_filed
fields.description: ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD' the docket was filed.

fields.name: docket.argument
fields.description: What was SAID at oral argument. Use for anything a judge or counsel said aloud.

fields.name: cluster.docket_id
fields.description: The docket this decision belongs to.

fields.name: cluster.scan_pdf_url
fields.description: URL of the scanned record PDF, null if none.

fields.name: cluster.scan_pages
fields.description: What a scanned page SHOWS: photographs, exhibits, signatures, diagrams, stamps.

fields.name: cluster.scan_text
fields.description: What the scanned record SAYS in words, page by page, once parsed to text.

fields.name: opinion.cluster_id
fields.description: The decision this opinion belongs to.

fields.name: opinion.author_str
fields.description: Authoring judge, e.g. 'Berzon'. Match with LIKE '%Berzon%'.

fields.name: opinion.token_count
fields.description: Approximate token count of the opinion.

fields.name: opinion.plain_text
fields.description: What the opinion DISCUSSES. Full written text, 25-40k tokens.

fields.name: opinion.chunks
fields.description: The same opinion split into passages. Use when the condition is about one passage, not the whole opinion.

fields.name: citation.cited_opinion_id
fields.description: The opinion being cited, may be null.

fields.name: citation.cited_cite
fields.description: Cite string as printed, e.g. '490 U.S. 386' for Graham v. Connor.

fields.name: scan_page.cluster_id
fields.description: The decision this page belongs to.

fields.name: scan_page.pdf_path
fields.description: Local path of the source PDF.

fields.name: scan_page.image_path
fields.description: Local path of the rasterized page image.

fields.name: audio.docket_id
fields.description: The docket this recording belongs to.

fields.name: audio.local_path
fields.description: Local path of the downloaded recording.

fields.name: audio_segment.audio_id
fields.description: The recording this segment came from.
